title: Cheesy Turnip Quesadilla
description: A flavorful and spicy Venezuelan-inspired quesadilla filled with sautéed turnips and a blend of cheeses.

ingredients.name: Nutty Cheese
ingredients.notes: such as Manchego or Queso Fresco

ingredients.name: Cheesy Cheese
ingredients.notes: such as Mozzarella or Monterey Jack

instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add the sliced turnips and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
3. In a separate pan or griddle, warm the tortillas over medium heat for 1-2 minutes on each side.
4. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the cooked turnips onto half of each tortilla, followed by a sprinkle of cheese.
5. Fold the tortillas in half to enclose the filling and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the tortillas are crispy.
6. Flip the quesadillas and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the other side is also crispy and golden brown.
7. Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot with your favorite toppings, such as salsa or sour cream.
